reference_reading: User-supplied stills show readable horizontal combat lane, airborne pickups, several entry elevations and supported platforms. They do not establish measured spawn rates, enemy HP or exact first-20-second timing; opening description is user observation.

baseline.layout: scripts/first_call.gd: six gated zones,17 solid props,9600 pixels
baseline.tuning: Current canonical Tony6 damage/0.15s; Sean24/1.0s;40HP Flushfiend gives7/2 hits. Sean2–3sec is perceived feel, not current configured interval.
baseline.newer_content: Septic Air Force is integrated per current handoff: slow non-hunting swarm. Do not repurpose it as an aggressive flying attacker. Eight-way aiming exists; use current code, not old horizontal-only baseline.

recommendation.structure: Continuous forward encounters punctuated by one midlevel set piece and the boss; replace six mandatory clear-all stops in the proposed revision. Preserve existing gate art for meaningful machinery set piece/boss lock, not every wave.
recommendation.density: More fragile bodies and simultaneous roles, not simply more high-HP pursuers. Maintain escape lanes and distinct enemy projectile silhouettes.
recommendation.pacing: First20s should establish four combat roles with staggered overlap, a visible pickup opportunity and terrain choice. Begin fighting within2s, no new mandatory tutorial.
recommendation.length: Retain9600 as planning envelope; target4–6min including initial40–60sec boss. Instrument human clears; shrink empty distance rather than pad HP. Boss60–90sec only later if attack variety warrants it.
recommendation.count_note: Provisional authored count excluding swarm decorative bugs and boss summons; not infinite spawns. Full mission count proposal below totals90 ordinary entities, not90 species.
recommendation.direct_pressure: Initial cap6 visible,2 shooters,at most3 independent attack patterns. Peak8 visible for<=5sec, keep shooter cap2 until slice validates readability. Entry/warning bodies count.
recommendation.projectile_budget: Initial8 hostile bullets,peak12 for<=5sec. Treat as ceilings not quotas; never all aimed simultaneously. Mechanics/Engineering consolidated recommendation.

first_twenty_seconds.beat: 2 forward runners enter visible ground lane; immediate shots and1–3-hit kills. No rear damage before first forward enemy is readable.
2 more forward runners and1 rear entrant with visible edge arrival cue; first low pipe step gives an optional elevated route.
1 perched shooter winds up a slow aimed shot while2 runners cross below. Pickup carrier traverses overhead; first reward is reachable from low platform or drops into clear floor.
2 floor-emerging enemies appear from distinct premarked grates and2 runners enter opposite side; do not mark the hero current landing point.
2 aggressive flyers cross distinct arcs plus1 ground runner; perched shooter fires only if projectile-pattern budget permits.
2 final runners and optional upper-route reward; briefly thin attack pressure while action continues into next space.

roster.existing: Flushfiend runner; Septic Air Force environmental wanderer; Hallowed Widow art exists but playable flight must be verified by Engineering. Clogfather is separate boss scope.
proposal: New stationary projectile species: floor/perch mounts and readable windup
New emergence species: floor/ceiling variants share core behavior; background entry also reusable
New traversal/skirmisher species: fast mover with background/viewer-side entry animation
Optional fourth species only if needed for aggressive flight; otherwise validate existing Widow for that role
roster.principle: Six entrance directions do not require six new species. Keep names, art and lore provisional with Bestiary/Storyboarding. Never change approved swarm non-hunting behavior.

platform_mockups.intent: Low pipe bundle leads to supported mid catwalk; ground lane under catwalk remains passable. Perched shooter near x570,y320; forward ground arrivals right, warned rear left; overhead pickup aroundy235. Entrance positions illustrative, not exact runtime homes.

Connected maintenance structure with60px rises, optional high lane and clear lower lane. Supports behind play plane are explicitly decorative; real solid machinery distinctly blocks. Perched shooter on upper lane, background vent to right, ceiling entry away from mandatory landing. At least120px landing widths.

Rooted fatberg on right, low forward weak point reachable by shorter starter range, at least640px connected combat floor; optional low ledges cannot become mandatory safe spots. Large named boss bar; one readable primary hazard plus limited adds.

geometry_contract: Current86px jump is hard constraint unless Mechanics explicitly proposes change. Required rises<=60,gaps<=80,landings>=120; validate both heroes. Structural background supports do not imply solid wall; collider/material language must distinguish pass-through support and solid prop. Layered platforms need intentional one-way tops and clearance beneath, not solid rectangles filling floor-to-deck.

entry_contract.side: Spawn outside viewport with early visible approach, never materialize touching hero. Rear entry is allowed by requested direction; cue and reaction distance scale with speed.
entry_contract.floor_ceiling: Use grate/vent movement or silhouette cue and fixed telegraphed landing; commit landing before attack, never home onto hero during descent.
entry_contract.depth: Animate background/foreground scale into a fixed play-plane destination. Harmless and untargetable before joining plane; clear landing marker and short settle before contact/shooting. Never obscure hero with giant foreground silhouette.
entry_contract.budget: All entry telegraphs/active bodies consume population budget; max1 depth entry at once. Cancel/reselect threatened landing if player occupies it.
entry_contract.timing: Initial candidates0.6–0.9s warning,0.25–0.4s settle; Mechanics to validate against movement and projectile speeds.

progression: Proposal supersedes old global kill-all rule only after implementation and story text agree. Finite encounters wake by forward progress. Do not require hunting every missed runner behind camera; resolve encounter retirement explicitly, never silently count retired bodies as kills. Boss defeat + exit finishes mission. Existing ending saying last of them must change if enemies may remain.

clogfather.completion_gate: The redesigned first mission is incomplete without playable boss; wave fallback is not final acceptance.
clogfather.proposal: Three escalating pattern combinations, low exposed weak point, no long invulnerability padding, limited2 add cap included in global pressure. Retune HP/windows after chosen starter DPS; do not preserve720 blindly.
clogfather.preboss: Checkpoint/heal, clear traversal projectiles and active pursuit safely before fight, restore boss state on retry; avoid repeating long approach.
clogfather.story: Boss aftermath requires Storyboarding script; portal is not automatically approved.

acceptance: Ordinary baseline enemies need1–3 successful hits from BOTH starters for chosen profile; armor/boss exceptions explicit
No repeated2–3sec helpless firing gaps; test misses, firing while moving/aiming and perceived shot feedback
Hero can take upper/lower route while attacked; perched enemies reachable with actual aiming/range

No all-clear door after every small wave; continuous run-and-gun flow demonstrated
Clogfather is playable at end, retryable and finishable with either starter
All mockups labeled concepts, new species/counts/tuning labeled proposals; report delivered by Engineering
